title: The Voice of Thrall Retired, Then Came Back to Run Warcraft
hook: Chris Metzen voiced Thrall, retired from Blizzard in 2016, then came back to run all of Warcraft. Did you know the Warchief and the King of the Alliance share a voice?
script: Did you know the voice of Thrall is the same man who helped write Warcraft's entire story? His name is Chris Metzen. He joined Blizzard back in the nineties, when the very first Warcraft game was being made. Over the next two decades he helped shape Warcraft, Diablo, and StarCraft. He wrote the lore, and he also stepped into the recording booth. Metzen voiced Thrall, the orc who became Warchief of the Horde. He also voiced King Varian Wrynn, the leader of the Alliance. So the Horde and the Alliance were arguing with the same guy. Then in two thousand sixteen, after more than two decades at Blizzard, Metzen announced he was retiring. He said he was not going to some other company, he just wanted time with his family. Then in December two thousand twenty two, Blizzard brought him back as a creative advisor for Warcraft. In September two thousand twenty three, he was named executive creative director of the whole Warcraft franchise. Two months later he walked onto the BlizzCon stage and announced three expansions at once. The War Within, Midnight, and The Last Titan, together called the Worldsoul Saga. The man who voiced the Warchief now leads the universe he helped build. Which Metzen voice line still lives in your head? Follow for more gaming history.
